top_signals.title: Bank Stocks Mired in Correction as Yields Surge Before Earnings
top_signals.summary: Big US bank stocks are teetering in correction territory as the group kicks off earnings Tuesday, heightening the focus on executives’ outlook for the American consumer with long-term borrowing costs the highest in decades.
